lambda_variant: none: REST API calls StartSyncExecution on an Express state machine

lifecycle.reason: Step Functions has no runtime versions. The definition uses the JSONPath query language, the default for Amazon States Language.

contract.api: REST API, POST /orders, IAM or no authentication; SUCCEEDED 200, OrderRejected 422, TIMED_OUT 504, other failures 500
contract.correlation: x-correlation-id (1-64 letters, digits, hyphens) or the API request ID; returned in the response header and in the workflow input
contract.prerequisite: the account-level API Gateway CloudWatch role must exist for stage logging; the template does not manage it

instrumentation.logging: state machine log level ALL with execution data; API access log as JSON
instrumentation.tracing: X-Ray on the stage and the state machine

review: pending: promote status to supported after a person reviews the sandbox evidence
